findings.reason: one sentence fixing the config key form (prefixes, or an exact id plus one prefix-only sibling in the fixture) turns a gate that can pass a narrowed lookup into one that would fail it.
findings.text: the done-when builds the directory view "over a fixture session transcript for each model the base revision's window table serves, with a fixture configuration the check supplies itself", so the check declares both the ids it tests and the windows it expects; the base table is prefix-matched (`_context_window` uses `model.startswith(prefix)`, reckon/crew/directory.py:59-67), so a session on a model the base table serves only as a prefix sibling — a differently dated `claude-haiku-4-5` snapshot, say, where the catalogue names one dated id — reports 1,000,000 at base and `None` at head, and the check cannot see it because the fixture never names that id; the Deliverable's own promise is that no row's context window becomes unmeasured
